title: stellaria alsine subsp. undulata
intro: Stellaria alsine subsp. undulata, commonly known as Alpine Chickweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which may contribute to its use in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. Additionally, Alpine Chickweed has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and digestive issues, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
